_comment: emtk layouts of the Spectra tool's own panels (Browse toolbar and table, Download, the Add-to-MMFDB buttons and log, the Overview buttons and tables). The Overview fields, the endpoint form and the component detail reuse the Qt specs (overview.view.json, endpoint_auth.view.json, the mmfdb-admin fluorophore.view.json).
